purpose: One frozen, exposed diagnostic pilot. Q1-Q10 reuse the direct-DB trial gold IDs; P11-P15 add phrasing and negative cases. Not a sealed holdout.

cases.question: What is the best way to set a static default in Formly, and what changes when the model already has a value or the default is dynamic?
In Formly v6, how should I conditionally hide or disable a field, and what happens to the model value and control when a field is hidden?
I built a custom field component. How do I register and use it in a form, and is the field's key the same thing as its type?
Can I add my own property to props and expect a Material control to use it automatically?
Does resetOnHide: false keep the hidden control registered?
What differs between options.resetModel() and calling Angular's form.reset() directly?
If I return an Observable from a Formly onInit hook, who unsubscribes? What if I call subscribe() myself?
Why might changing an expression from templateOptions.disabled to props.disabled alter behavior under a disabled parent?
Can I use a registered type's defaults and inheritance while overriding only one props value?
When do I need a Formly wrapper instead of a custom field type?
An API value arrives after my form appeared. Will defaultValue notice it, or should I update the model?
If I hide a field and set resetOnHide to false, do both its saved value and FormControl stay around?
I registered a password component under a Formly type. Is the field key what chooses that component?
How does Formly connect to Stripe payment intents?
In Formly v7, is there a signals-only replacement for expressions?
